sourceChecks.text: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ペオルの事件でイスラエル人とともに殺された女性はコズビと記され、ミディアンの族長ツルの娘と説明されます。
